messages:
Sam: quick sync — Acme POC: we need final prompt inventory + eval plan. Also pricing for a 2-week dedicated trial and the SQ answers before Friday. Any blockers?
Riya: got it. working on prompt inventory now. can you confirm target use cases? (email summarization + intent classification + doc Q&A)
Sam: yes those three. main success criteria: intent accuracy >= 92% on eval set, summary ROUGE-L >= 0.45, P95 latency <= 350ms, no data leaves VPC. budget ask: trial cost estimate for 5 GPUs.
Jordan: perf note: 5 GPUs will handle throughput but we need KV cache warming for doc Q&A. also want an automatic fallback to a smaller FP16 model if quantized variant trips quality alerts.
Riya: for baseline prompts i'll start with short + long variants and edge cases (ambiguous intent, truncated context). sample set below:

```
### Summarization (short)
Instruction: "Summarize the customer's message in 2 bullet points, include action items."
### Intent classification
Label: [support, billing, feature_request, other]
### Document Q&A
Prompt: "Based on the attached policy doc, answer: Is remote access allowed? Be concise. If uncertain, say 'insufficient info'."
```

Riya: will push a CSV with ~120 example prompts + expected outputs to the shared drive by EOD. includes QA pairs + labels.
Priya: success metrics + eval cadence: run eval on 100 holdout prompts/day, daily dashboard. trigger paging alert if accuracy drops >3% vs baseline. also add human-in-loop fallback for ambiguous intents.
Sam: pricing question from finance: do we bill trial as metered usage or fixed sandbox fee? Sales needs a firm estimate to confirm with Acme.
Laura: recommend fixed trial fee (covers reserved capacity) + metered overage for heavy usage. i'll draft numbers and attach a cost breakdown spreadsheet.
security-bot: SQ status: customer completed 40% of security questionnaire. outstanding: encryption at rest details, KMS integration, audit log retention, and DPA status.
Jordan: blocker: if customer requires customer-managed keys we need Legal + eng to sign off on DPA and KMS architecture. Legal already reviewing the template; anticipating 48-72h.
Riya: model selection note: recommend Redstone-3 8B quantized as baseline for latency, Redstone-13B FP16 as a quality fallback. will include perf vs quality matrix in the doc.
Sam: action items recap:
- Riya: upload prompt CSV + eval script + baseline prompts (owner Riya)
- Jordan: confirm fallback model config, KV cache warm strategy, and perf numbers (owner Jordan)
- Laura: produce fixed trial fee + overage estimate and spreadsheet (owner Laura)
- Security / Legal: finish SQ answers, confirm DPA timeline (owner Security / Legal)
Priya: proposed timeline: kickoff Mon (5 business days). eval-ready artifacts by Wed. syncs Tue/Thu for presales updates.
Sam: perfect. i'll update the presales doc and cadence. @Riya if we see regressions on the quantized model, include clear rollback steps to FP16 and a quick checklist for customers.
Riya: noted. i'll include rollback steps, perf matrix, and an automated smoke test for regressions.
Sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
Sam: i'll send the summary to Acme after Laura posts the cost sheet.
